components.name: Open Plug Border
components.description: A circular border interrupted at the lower right. Exclude the plug and cancellation cross.

components.name: Two-Prong Electrical Plug
components.description: A rounded plug body with flat upper edge, two straight prongs, and a curved descending cord. Exclude all border shapes and cancellation marks.

components.name: Diagonal Cancellation Cross
components.description: Two straight diagonal strokes crossing at their centers. Exclude all surrounding subjects; this is a geometric cancellation mark, not a letter glyph.
